name: Weekly digest
description: One email a week from Husan: what I wrote, read and built, plus a few links worth your time.
intro: One email a week, every Sunday. What I wrote, what I read, what I built or broke, and a few links worth your time. It takes about five minutes to read, which is less than I spend picking the subject line.
inside: Writing: new essays, and the half-formed notes that did not make it into one.
Reading: the book or paper of the week, and whether it was worth the hours.
Building: what moved on the robots and the side projects, including what broke.
Links: three or four things from around the internet I could not stop thinking about.
